summary: Copy LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md into the packaged desktop app's Resources folder, so every installed build carries the MIT notices of the code it contains.

desktop.reason: No runtime code reads the files. They are packaging-only extraResources; src/main, src/preload and src/renderer are untouched.

reactNativeIos.reason: apps/mobile is untouched. The iOS app is built by EAS and contains none of the desktop files the notices cover.

nativeAndroid.reason: apps/android is untouched. The Android app is built by Gradle and contains none of the desktop files the notices cover.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No wire protocol, IPC channel or handler changes. src/shared and src/server are untouched.

storageDataMigration.reason: No schema, migration or persisted-state changes.

automated: tests/unit/licence-files-packaged.test.ts checks that the effective extraResources of electron-builder.yml and electron-builder.signed.yml (base plus overlay, the way extends appends arrays) copy both files, and that both files exist at the repo root. It fails when either entry is removed.
notExercised: No packaged build was produced locally, so the files were not seen inside a .app, NSIS install or AppImage. The next release-build.yml run is the first packaged proof.
